Name: Tachi's More Accurate Telephone Retexture
Author: PrblyTachi
Description:
Ever felt bothered by how different the telephone's sprites are from the portrait? Well, then this mod is for you.
After seeing Zilch's "Calling from afar", i couldn't help but notice the glaring difference in those textures, so i took some time and made a new one!

Installation:
Just Unzip the file and drop it into the Mods folder, you'll need Content Patcher for it to work.

Downloads.Description: Adds a new texture.. GMCM compatibility implemented, so you can choose between the new and the older version at will.

Manifest.Name: Tachi's More Accurate Telephone Retexture
Manifest.Description: Makes the Aswering Machine Portrait more accurate to the sprite.
